caption: The drawing features a square composition bordered by thin double lines, one dark blue and one light blue, set against a beige background. Within the square, there is a central circular shape from which eight elongated, petal-like forms radiate outward, resembling a flower with a blue center. Surrounding this flower motif, a series of jagged, stepped lines form an angular border, creating a geometric frame within the square. Additional small dots are scattered throughout the inner area, especially within the flower and along the geometric border. The image uses pale blue, white, and light grey tones for its lines and shapes, contrasting softly against the beige background. There are no text or other objects present in the drawing.
title: Candlewick Bedspread
